quickRoute: Five diagnostic probes route to individual lessons. Use Quick recall, then each independent lesson checkpoint and the mixed recall.
fullRoute: Follow limits, derivative meaning, composite rules, accumulation, and initial conditions. Predict in each activity and save explanations in notes.

support.reason: Recover factoring, canceled-domain restrictions, and algebraic manipulation.
Reconnect functions, coordinates, average rates, and finite difference quotients.
Review radians and standard trigonometric values.
Recover exponentials, logarithms, and their real domains.
Interpret rates and accumulated quantities with consistent units.
Study the full first calculus course, including first-time development of these ideas.
Continue with integration techniques and other second-course topics beyond this refresher.
Use derivatives and integrals to connect position, velocity, acceleration, and motion.
Prepare for continuous field and accumulated physical-quantity models.
Build toward differential equations and advanced engineering mathematics.
Interpret changing and accumulated electrical quantities in circuit models.
Connect continuous signal rates and accumulation.
Prepare the calculus reasoning used alongside discrete signal methods.

escalation.text: For first-time instruction, use the linked free Calculus Volume 1 sections and the CSC 208 course destination. CSC 209 extends beyond this refresher. Algebra, function, trig, and logarithm refreshers supply available prerequisite support.
